content: Upgrade your Apache 2 to 2.4.71 TODAY: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-119618 RCE w/ score 9.8 ain't no fun.

Java scored a 8.1 CVE: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/cve-2026-114938 https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-11-17 There is no known exploit yet for Dataverse/Payara, but in the age of AI that's just a matter of time. Anyone running Dataverse 6.0 or newer should update their JRE installation ASAP. (Quite a few interesting places where we are using Base64)

I just triggered the maintenance run on our container images. Images for 6.11, 6.12 and 6.12.1 shall receive updated images with patched JREs soon. Update: bah, the Temurin images for Java 21 have not been updated yet, so no updates for our images yet. Will keep ya posted.
Just in: please update your NGINX servers. https://www.wiz.io/blog/nginx-http2-rce-vulnerabilities Score 9.2, even very old releases affected as soon as you have HTTP2 active in your configuration!
